statistical_unit: smoke validation only; no inferential claim
primary_outcome: DSR = deadline-satisfied generated service requests / all generated service requests
decision_rule: A positive paired 95% DSR interval across training seeds and workload seeds motivates untouched held-out confirmation; an interval crossing zero establishes neither benefit nor equivalence. Also inspect admission and conditional success, energy and latency for tradeoffs.
scope: Exploratory MARL pilot. Only the upper reward DSR denominator changes from current generated count to fixed 28 requests per slot; 28 approximates 27.920633 mean generated service requests per step in the previous 150000-step baseline. The evaluation DSR, lower reward, model architectures, default methods, and Chapter 4 objective are unchanged.
